How a record earns its status

Status is computed from evidence, never asserted

Officially verified

Exact product page on the brand’s own domain, the product still appears in the brand’s published product index, the image comes from that index, and warranty terms were captured from the page itself.

Authorized source confirmed

Exact product page on the brand-owned domain, still listed in the brand’s published index, with the brand’s own image. Warranty wording was not captured, so the record sends you to the page for it.

Manufacturer source confirmed

The link resolves to a brand-owned domain but the listing could not be confirmed as live. No record currently sits at this level.

Verification pending

Held for records whose source cannot be resolved to a brand-owned domain, or whose official image cannot be obtained. Records that reach this state are removed rather than shown.

Every image comes from the brand’s own published product index, so no record relies on a stock photo or a reseller’s photograph. Each image is also screened to exclude photographs containing people, so the directory shows the product itself rather than a model wearing it. Any record whose official image could not be obtained, or whose only image contained a person, was removed rather than shown with a substitute. Prices, country of origin and importer details are left blank rather than estimated: a guessed price on a counterfeit-avoidance platform is worse than no price. Prices are shown only where they were read from the brand's own page, with the date they were checked and a warning once they age past two weeks. 0 records carry a checked price; 0 do not. Run the included refresh script and use Import prices to fill the rest, or record a price yourself from any record.

ASLI n NASLI does not promote the cheapest seller. It identifies the most trustworthy original source.
Original product → verified source → authorized seller → clear evidence. This directory does not process orders, take commission, or list marketplace sellers. Always confirm the current price, warranty and stock on the brand’s own page before you buy.
